text:
alex: FYI seeing a sudden p99 tail spike for tenant 'cartly' on continuous-batcher after the midnight rollout. p99 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.6s, p95 ~420ms -> ~900ms. small prompts workload.

maggie: ugh. any errors in logs or auth failures? link to quick graph?

alex: no obvious 5xx. no auth or billing alerts. attaching trace snippet and batcher metrics:
```
metrics.batch.wait_window_ms: 12 -> 80
metrics.batch.avg_size: 3 -> 2.1
metrics.latency.p99: 0.22 -> 1.6
```
seems hold window bubbled up, but not sure why.

juan: did the canary change the default grace/linger settings? last change merged yesterday adjusted grace -> 80ms for medium models.

alex: yes we rolled config PR #4827 that set default grace_ms=80 for better throughput on large-char sequences. rollout to prod midnight.

emma: that explains increase in wait time. small prompts are starving; grace up means tiny requests wait for coalescing and occasionally one request holds up a batch causing outliers. we saw similar before but usually at different thresholds.

maggie: can we reproduce? steps to repro please so support can confirm impact for cartly tenant.

alex: repro steps I used:
1) spawn 200 rps of tiny prompts (avg tokens=8) across 20 clients
2) enable continuous-batcher with grace_ms=80 and max_batch_size=16
3) observe p99 on request traces, note tail when one large prompt enters mid-batch

I can share k6 script if useful.

juan: quick mitigation options:
- reduce grace_ms back to 12 for small prompt cohorts
- set min_coalesce_threshold=2 so we don't wait for single tiny reqs
- fallback routing for tenant cartly to greedy batching

emma: preference is staged: roll canary with grace_ms=12 for regions serving small-prompt tenants, or set tenant-level override for cartly.

alex: trying tenant override now: patched config:
```
tenants.cartly.batch_config:
  grace_ms: 12
  min_coalesce: 2
```
pushed to canary cluster.

oncall-bot: deploy started for service=continuous-batcher cluster=canary-1 by alex

maggie: while that lands, add a short-term alert to catch grace_ms > 50 when avg_prompt_tokens < 20 per tenant.

juan: agreed. I'll add a Grafana rule and a digitalocean job to tickle if threshold breached.

alex: canary shows p99 back down to ~240ms after override. rolling to prod for cartly only.

emma: great. we should follow-up with a config matrix doc mapping workload shapes to grace_ms/min_coalesce settings. ticket created: INF-9876.

maggie: also capture a postmortem note: the config change was applied org-wide without traffic-shape exemptions. next rollout checklist add 'traffic_shape_impact: small_prompts'.

alex: noted. closing loop after prod rollout completes. thanks all :thumbsup:
